title: Authenticate live cubic class-number artifacts
objective: Separate producer-issued live cubic class-number authentication from mandatory detached certificate replay so public caching is cheap and forge-resistant

oracles: Full detached cubic class-number certificate replay

validation: node --test --test-name-pattern=public cubic class number uses cached unconditional Minkowski evidence test/number-field-class-unit-public.cjs
node --test --test-name-pattern=bounded cubic class numbers replay every quotient p-line test/number-field-global-arithmetic.cjs

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern=public cubic class number uses cached unconditional Minkowski evidence test/number-field-class-unit-public.cjs
node --test --test-name-pattern=bounded cubic class numbers replay every quotient p-line test/number-field-global-arithmetic.cjs

handoff.summary: Producer-complete cubic class-number results now carry an immutable module-issued live seal bound to their exact field, source result, certificate, factor base, relations, presentation, and diagnostics. Public class_number validates that seal on initial insertion and every cache read without invoking detached arithmetic replay. Direct constructors, transferred seals, detached wrappers, and later mutation fail closed; from_dict retains full exact replay.
risks: Live acceptance relies on the same module-private issuance-token convention as AuthenticatedBuchmannLenstraProjection; detached or cross-process artifacts deliberately require full replay.
The source snapshot serializes live relation metadata on each cache read; measured cached acceptance is 0.224s for the h=3 cubic, versus about 41s for detached replay.
next_steps: Central integration should rerun the broad number-field and platform gates.
The producer itself remains about 7.45s on the measured h=3 cubic; this change removes replay overhead rather than optimizing relation collection.
